name: CCAvenue Gateway Integration for WooCommerce
author: malun728

sections.description:
CCAvenue Gateway Integration for WooCommerce lets you securely accept online payments through your CCAvenue merchant account directly on your WooCommerce store.

The plugin provides a smooth and reliable payment experience with support for both redirect checkout and embedded iframe checkout modes, allowing store owners to choose the checkout flow that best fits their business.

Built specifically for WooCommerce, the plugin is lightweight, easy to configure, and compatible with modern WooCommerce features including Checkout Blocks and HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage).

Whether you are testing your integration in sandbox mode or processing live customer transactions, the plugin helps you manage secure and seamless CCAvenue payments directly from your WooCommerce checkout.

Key Features

  • Adds CCAvenue as a WooCommerce payment gateway
  • Secure payment processing through your CCAvenue merchant account
  • Supports both Redirect Checkout and iFrame Checkout modes
  • Sandbox mode for safe testing before going live
  • Automatic WooCommerce order status updates after payment
  • Compatible with WooCommerce Checkout Blocks
  • HPOS compatibility support
  • Optional debug logging for troubleshooting payment issues
  • Simple setup using Merchant ID, Access Code, and Working Key
  • Dedicated admin dashboard with setup guidance and help section
  • Clean and lightweight integration built for performance

Easy Setup

Getting started is simple:

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Open WooCommerce → Settings → Payments
  3. Enable “CCAvenue Gateway”
  4. Enter your Merchant ID, Access Code, and Working Key
  5. Choose Sandbox or Live mode
  6. Start accepting payments securely through CCAvenue

External services

This plugin connects to the CCAvenue payment gateway to securely process payments.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active. If WooCommerce is not active, this plugin will automatically deactivate itself.

What details do I need from CCAvenue?

You need your Merchant ID, Access Code, and Working Key from your CCAvenue merchant account.

Does the plugin support sandbox testing?

Yes. You can enable sandbox mode in the gateway settings and test the checkout flow before switching to live credentials.

Can I use iframe checkout instead of redirect checkout?

Yes. The plugin supports both redirect and iframe checkout modes.

Does the plugin update WooCommerce orders after payment?

Yes. The plugin processes CCAvenue payment responses and updates the WooCommerce order status based on the transaction result.

Is debug logging available?

Yes. You can enable debug logging in the gateway settings to help troubleshoot payment requests and responses.

Where can I get help for this plugin?

Open CCAvenue Gateway > Help for setup steps and testing guidance. You can also use the plugin page on WordPress.org for support requests.
